Here are clear notes on your topics:

1️⃣ Dimensions of Religion

The dimensions of religion are the main parts or aspects that make up a religion. Scholars like Ninian Smart explained that religions have several important dimensions.

The 7 Main Dimensions of Religion:

  1. Doctrinal (Belief) Dimension

    • The teachings and beliefs of a religion.

    • Example: Christians believe in the Holy Trinity in Bible.

  2. Mythological (Narrative) Dimension

    • Sacred stories and legends.

    • Example: The story of creation in the Bible.

  3. Ethical (Moral) Dimension

    • Rules about right and wrong.

    • Example: The Ten Commandments.

  4. Ritual (Practical) Dimension

    • Religious ceremonies and practices.

    • Example: Prayer, fasting, baptism.

  5. Experiential (Emotional) Dimension

    • Religious feelings or spiritual experiences.

    • Example: Feeling peace during prayer.

  6. Social (Institutional) Dimension

    • The community and organisation of a religion.

    • Example: Churches, pastors, congregations.

  7. Material Dimension

    • Physical objects and places connected to religion.

    • Example: Churches, temples, sacred books.

2️⃣ Worship

Worship is showing love, respect, honour, and devotion to God or a higher power.

Forms of Worship:

  • Prayer

  • Singing hymns

  • Reading sacred texts

  • Offering sacrifices

  • Fasting

For example, Christians worship in churches on Sundays and read from the Bible.

Worship can be:

  • Private – done alone (personal prayer)

  • Public – done in a group (church service)

3️⃣ Who Am I? (Religious Identity)

In religion, “Who am I?” refers to:

  • Your identity as a human being

  • Your relationship with God

  • Your purpose in life

For example:

  • In Christianity, humans are seen as created in God’s image.

  • Many religions teach that humans have a soul and a purpose.

This question helps people understand:

  • Their values

  • Their beliefs

  • Their role in society

what is add gitinore

ChatGPT said:

A .gitignore file is a special file used in Git repositories to tell Git which files or folders it should ignore and not track. It’s very useful when you have files you don’t want to share or commit, like:

  • Local configuration files (config.json, .env)

  • Sensitive data (passwords, API keys)

  • Build or temporary files (node_modules/, dist/, .DS_Store)

For your project, if you create a GitHub repository to host your webpage, a .gitignore file might include things like:

Code
# Ignore system files
.DS_Store

# Ignore local environment configs
.env

# Ignore node_modules if using Node.js
node_modules/

You don’t need a .gitignore for just HTML/CSS/JS files unless you have extra files (like configs or API keys) that you don’t want uploaded.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<title>Stainless Steel Solution</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
body { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; margin:0; background:#f4f4f4; }
header { background:#004080; color:white; padding:20px; text-align:center; }
section { padding:20px; max-width:1200px; margin:auto; }
table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:30px; background:white; }
th, td { border:1px solid #ddd; padding:10px; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle; }
th { background:#0066cc; color:white; }
.btn { padding:6px 10px; background:#28a745; color:white; border:none; cursor:pointer; margin:2px; border-radius:4px; }
.btn:hover { background:#218838; }
.cart { background:white; padding:20px; margin:20px 0; border-radius:8px; }
#searchBar { padding:8px; width:100%; max-width:400px; margin-bottom:20px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #ccc; }
#noResults { color:red; font-weight:bold; }
.category-header { background:#0073e6; color:white; font-weight:bold; text-align:left; padding-left:10px; }
footer { background:#004080; color:white; text-align:center; padding:20px; margin-top:20px; }
.low-stock { background-color: #ffcccc; font-weight:bold; }
.admin-link { display:block; text-align:center; margin:20px auto; padding:10px; background:#ff6600; color:white; text-decoration:none; width:220px; font-weight:bold; border-radius:6px; }
.admin-section { text-align:center; margin:30px 0; }
img.item-img { width:60px; height:60px; object-fit:cover; margin-right:10px; vertical-align:middle; border-radius:6px; }
.item-name { vertical-align: middle; }
</style>
<script>
let cart = [];
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'Brianique3';

/* Images now use online links so you don't need to upload image files */
let allItems = [
{category:"Tubes", name:"Stainless Steel Tube 316L", size:"3\"", quantity:50, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Stainless_steel_tube.jpg"},
{category:"Tubes", name:"Stainless Steel Tube 316L", size:"2.5\"", quantity:10, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Stainless_steel_tube.jpg"},
{category:"Tubes", name:"Stainless Steel Tube 316L", size:"2\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Stainless_steel_tube.jpg"},
{category:"Tubes", name:"Stainless Steel Tube 316L", size:"1.5\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0f/Stainless_steel_tube.jpg"},

{category:"Tees", name:"316L Tee", size:"1\"", quantity:100, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5e/Pipe_tee.jpg"},
{category:"Tees", name:"316L Tee", size:"2\"", quantity:50, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5e/Pipe_tee.jpg"},
{category:"Tees", name:"316L Tee", size:"1.5\"", quantity:10, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5e/Pipe_tee.jpg"},

{category:"Elbows", name:"316L Elbow 90 degrees", size:"2\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3e/Pipe_elbow.jpg"},
{category:"Elbows", name:"316L Elbow 90 degrees", size:"1.5\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3e/Pipe_elbow.jpg"},
{category:"Elbows", name:"316L Elbow 90 degrees", size:"1\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3e/Pipe_elbow.jpg"},

{category:"Butterfly Valves", name:"Butterfly valve tri clamp 316L", size:"4\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/21/Butterfly_valve.jpg"},
{category:"Butterfly Valves", name:"Butterfly valve tri clamp 316L", size:"3\"", quantity:10, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/21/Butterfly_valve.jpg"},
{category:"Butterfly Valves", name:"Butterfly valve tri clamp 316L", size:"2.5\"", quantity:15, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/21/Butterfly_valve.jpg"},

{category:"Check Valves", name:"Non-return check valve 316L", size:"2\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7c/Check_valve.jpg"},
{category:"Check Valves", name:"Non-return check valve 316L", size:"1.5\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7c/Check_valve.jpg"},

{category:"SMS Couplings", name:"SMS Union Coupling 316L", size:"3\"", quantity:10, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4d/Pipe_coupling.jpg"},
{category:"SMS Couplings", name:"SMS Union Coupling 316L", size:"2\"", quantity:10, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4d/Pipe_coupling.jpg"},
{category:"SMS Couplings", name:"SMS Union Coupling 316L", size:"1.5\"", quantity:20, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4d/Pipe_coupling.jpg"},

{category:"Tube Hangers", name:"Tube hanger 304L", size:"2\"", quantity:25, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/Pipe_clamp.jpg"},
{category:"Tube Hangers", name:"Tube hanger 304L", size:"1.5\"", quantity:50, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/Pipe_clamp.jpg"},
{category:"Tube Hangers", name:"Tube hanger 304L", size:"1\"", quantity:50, price:"TBA", image:"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/Pipe_clamp.jpg"}
];

const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 10;

function addToCart(item, size){
let existing = cart.find(c => c.item === item && c.size === size);
if(existing){ existing.qty += 1; } else { cart.push({item:item, size:size, qty:1}); }
displayCart();
}

function removeFromCart(index){ cart.splice(index,1); displayCart(); }
function changeQty(index, delta){ cart[index].qty += delta; if(cart[index].qty<=0){ cart.splice(index,1); } displayCart(); }

function displayCart(){
let cartDiv = document.getElementById('cartItems');
cartDiv.innerHTML = '';
cart.forEach((c,i)=>{
cartDiv.innerHTML += `<p>${c.item} - ${c.size} | Qty: ${c.qty} <button class='btn' onclick='changeQty(${i},1)'>+</button> <button class='btn' onclick='changeQty(${i},-1)'>-</button> <button class='btn' onclick='removeFromCart(${i})'>Remove</button></p>`;
});
}

function checkout(){
if(cart.length===0){ alert('Cart is empty'); return; }
document.getElementById('checkout').style.display='block';
}

function searchItems(){
let query = document.getElementById('searchBar').value.toLowerCase();
let tableRows = '';
let resultsFound = false;
let categoriesAdded = new Set();

allItems.forEach(item=>{
if(item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || item.size.toLowerCase().includes(query) || item.category.toLowerCase().includes(query)){
resultsFound = true;

if(!categoriesAdded.has(item.category)){
tableRows += `<tr class='category-header'><td colspan='5'>${item.category}</td></tr>`;
categoriesAdded.add(item.category);
}

let lowStockClass = item.quantity <= LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD ? 'low-stock' : '';
let lowStockAlert = item.quantity <= LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD ? ' (Low Stock!)' : '';

tableRows += `<tr class='${lowStockClass}'>
<td><img class='item-img' src='${item.image}' alt='${item.name}'> <span class='item-name'>${item.name}</span></td>
<td>${item.size}</td>
<td>${item.quantity}${lowStockAlert}</td>
<td>${item.price}</td>
<td><button class='btn' onclick='addToCart("${item.name}","${item.size}")'>Add</button></td>
</tr>`;
}
});

document.getElementById('itemsTableBody').innerHTML = tableRows;
document.getElementById('noResults').style.display = resultsFound ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function openAdmin(){
let pass = prompt('Enter admin password:');
if(pass===ADMIN_PASSWORD){ window.open('admin.html','_blank'); }
else { alert('Incorrect password. Access denied.'); }
}

window.onload = function(){ searchItems(); };
</script>
</head>
<body>
<header>
<h1>Stainless Steel Solution</h1>
<p>Quality Stainless Steel Supplies</p>
</header>

<section>
<h2>Search Items</h2>
<input type='text' id='searchBar' placeholder='Search items...' onkeyup='searchItems()'>
